layers.authority: Taman Negara Pahang (Department of Wildlife and National Parks, under NRES)
layers.process: Every visitor must get an entry permit: RM1.00 a person (about A$0.35). A camera licence is RM5.00 a camera (A$1.75) and a fishing licence RM10.00 a rod (A$3.51). Camping inside the park is RM1.00 a person a night; a night in a wildlife hide is RM5.00 a person. A$ at RBA 30 Oct 2026: A$1 = MYR 2.853.

layers.authority: Taman Negara Pahang (Department of Wildlife and National Parks)
layers.process: Climbing Gunung Tahan needs a mountain guide: the page says a guide is compulsory. Fee RM1,200 for a 7-day trip per guide (about A$420.61), a maximum of 10 climbers per guide. A$ at RBA 30 Oct 2026: A$1 = MYR 2.853.

layers.authority: Taman Negara Pahang (Department of Wildlife and National Parks)
layers.process: The Gunung Tahan climb is closed from November to January, according to the park page. Check the park before planning.
